requirement: MTS, LCDM, wCDM, and CPL must face the same data split and residual diagnostic wherever possible.
reason: fair-comparative testing is the only way to separate real signal from pipeline quirks

requirement: Report Delta chi2, Delta AIC, and Delta BIC against fitted LCDM, wCDM, and CPL baselines.
reason: a small AIC win or near-draw is meaningful only if parameter counts are honest

requirement: Flag every branch whose best fit depends on prior edges before interpreting fit quality.
reason: edge-hitting branches are development clues, not evidence

requirement: Keep SH0ES/local-H0 pressure separate from no-SH0ES shape evidence.
reason: local calibration pressure can manufacture apparent support

requirement: Compressed CMB distance-prior results remain internal until an official perturbation likelihood path exists.
reason: distance priors are model-dependent and cannot replace perturbation physics
